name: solidity-commit-reveal-governance
title: Commit-reveal token voting
description: Token-escrowed commit/reveal proposals with quorum, immutable phase deadlines and refundable voting deposits.
assumptions: Voting weight is deposited tokens, not historical ERC20Votes snapshots. All deposits become withdrawable after reveal deadline, including unrevealed votes. Passed proposals are signals only; the contract does not execute treasury actions. Admin controls proposal creation.
